title: Mr. Sketch Scented Markers, Chisel Tip, Assorted Colors, 22 Count - Fun for Kids, Coloring, Spark Creativity, Arts & Crafts

reviews.title: Great markers
reviews.body: These markers are fantastic! The colors are bright, the scents are fun, and they last a long time without drying out. My child absolutely loves using them for art projects, and I appreciate how durable and high quality they are. Definitely a great buy!! Will not be disappointed! Some of the markers do have a funky smell but you could probably tell that by reading the scent! The thickness of the markers for the price is amazing!!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 12, 2025

reviews.title: Teacher List Must Have
reviews.body: They are Mr. Sketch, need I say more. Love these markers! They make making flip charts/posters for my classroom fun. Very bright, vibrant colors. Some what quick drying. Ink does bleed through my flip chart pages, but most poster markers do. I just put a scrap piece of paper behind the poster to prevent bleeding through. Best value for your money, scents make it even better.

reviews.title: Nostalgic purchase
reviews.body: When my daughter asked for these I was immediately taken back to my days at the school book store. The good and bad smells all had a wonderful memory. We love these markers. They color well and we like to sniff them and guess the smell. I do wish they would put the smell on the marker and not the box but it’s kind of fun not knowing in a way. I’m glad to be able to share such a fun childhood core memory with my daughter
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 15, 2026
